title: Передання та надходження
required_interaction: Вкладки вхідних/вихідних; повернений і частково опрацьований пакет.

implementation.view_model: WF-04 sender reconciliation, immutable portable package with real file bytes and provenance, issue tasks, configurable copy policy and external byte verification; explicit receiver decisions stay separate.
limitations: Browser file package (up to 32 MiB); no automatic network delivery or remote graph import.
SHA-256 verifies selected copy bytes; storage location and independence are declared by the user, not measured by the browser.
Consent records are opt-in; private consent evidence is excluded. Complete consent intake belongs to WF-05.
implementation.state_storage: Shared browser store; optional handover.preflight preserves old packets and adds explicit sender reconciliation.
permissions: media.write / physical.write / intake.send / intake.receive / legacy.write / legacy.review / capture.field, explicit archive grants
implementation.atomicity: Authorize and compare expected revision/package state; mutate clone; validate FK/type/version/hash; commit atomically.
